integrity: Proof and calculations provided; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
limitations: Exact Hodge pair of general smoothing and preservation of the special Mordell–Weil group are not proved. Semiquasihomogeneous Milnor-number invariance and Bertini are invoked as standard theorems. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Six Milnor-27 points and an Euler-minus-168 smoothing of the rank-twelve quartic model
